findings.title: Content-Security-Policy missing
findings.remediation: Define a CSP suited to the application's actual resource requirements.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy missing
findings.remediation: Set an explicit referrer policy appropriate for the application.

findings.title: No clear anti-framing policy found
findings.remediation: Use enforced CSP frame-ancestors; X-Frame-Options can be retained for legacy defense in depth. ALLOW-FROM is obsolete and unsupported by modern browsers.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy not present
findings.remediation: Consider restricting browser features that the application does not use.
